answer: An operator leases one numbered irrigation latch on a charted hay meadow. Only that holder may seat a uniquely serialled sluice anchor in the latch well and, at a surprise flood tick, release a one-shot tracer so its dye plume reaches the ditch weir's official sampler. Graders match anchor serial, dye batch, latch stamp, and the weir clock. A shared latch, a reused tracer, or an off-tick release is forfeited as one farm. Fielding N aliases costs N exclusive latches, N unique anchors, and N live flood-ticks no single ditch-tender can cover in the same hour.
